title.en: The shared laws on the grammar

statement.en: The five shared laws hold on the grammar for every carrier and relation: closure, finite runs (return, being drawn, rest, ends on lines), lumping and widening, with the models' laws proved from them. Balance is represented both ways as pairings of unit lists, near-definitional, and not derived.
statement.zh: 五条共律对每一载体与关系在文法上成立：闭包、有限运行（返、入、止、线上之终）、归并与扩大，模型之律由之证出。平衡以单位列表之配对两向表示，近乎定义，不推出。

laws.en: Closure. Lying within a relation's closure (every region closed under it that holds x holds y) is being x or reached from x. The closure is reflexive, transitive, holds every step, grows with the relation, is symmetric for a symmetric one and closed, nothing within it bears the relation beyond it, and a region is x's closure exactly where it holds x, is closed and lies within it. Under the converse it is the closure read backward; a closure through borrowed steps (each step of R′ a step of R, or a step of R from a taken at o) lies within o's or a's closure under R, and where R′ holds R and a lies within o's closure under R′, the two lie within o's closure under R′. A region of the steps of time that every step keeps holds from where it holds on: the closure at the successor along a line.
laws.zh: 闭包：在一关系之闭包内（凡对其封闭而含 x 之域皆含 y），即是 x 本身或为 x 所及。闭包自反、可传递、含每一步、随关系增大、对称关系下对称、自身封闭，其内者不以此关系及于其外；一域恰在含 x、封闭且在闭包内时为 x 之闭包。逆关系下之闭包即闭包之逆读；借步之闭包（R′ 之每一步或为 R 之步，或为在 o 处所取、自 a 起之 R 之步）在 o 或 a 于 R 下之闭包内，而 R′ 含 R 且 a 在 o 于 R′ 下之闭包内时，二者在 o 于 R′ 下之闭包内。每步皆守之时步之域，自其所守处以后皆守：即闭包于后继沿线。
declarations: Becoming.«所闭当且仅当同一或及»
Becoming.«及当且仅当一步而所闭»

laws.en: The frame's closed region and closure are the grammar's, by definition, and lying within a closure along a relation is being the start or reached on a line under the one of it.
laws.zh: 框架之封闭域与闭包即文法之所闭，依定义；沿一关系在闭包之内，即是起点本身或在其「一」之下的相续上为其所及。

laws.en: Lemmas on numbers and lists that the line laws use, each proved once here, below the frame: pigeonhole with no decidability (a list holding the first l.length + 1 values of a sequence holds two at one place), the numbers other than a given one, splitting a joined list, a value put in front of a sequence, totals that agree pointwise, and the filters, searches and counts the census of a step, the census of a run and the count laws need.
laws.zh: 诸线律所用的数与列表之引理，各于此（框架之下）证一次：无须可判定的鸽笼（持一序列前 l.length + 1 个值之列表在同一位持其二）、异于某一给定数之诸数、拆分相接之列表、置于序列之前的一值、逐点相同之总和，及步之清点、程之清点与计数之律所需之筛、查与计。

laws.en: Balance at one step. A perfect pairing of two finite lists under a relation conserves count; under the one it is exactly equal count, and under the empty relation equal count gives none. Lists paired from what comes in (before, given) to what goes on (after, taken) have after + taken = before + given, and every four numbers with that equation are lengths of unit lists so paired under the one. Near-definitional. Counting a region's units (a region read as a test, a modelling choice), a pairing keeps the count on every region not gone out of either way, which is exactly a region the relation does not cross and one closed under it and its converse, closed one way not being enough; under a class decided by a test a pairing is exactly equal count in every class, and the class does work (equal count pairs under the one, not under sameness), so a pairing under continuation relative to such a class keeps the count in every class. The census of a step: units listed once before and after it, under a continuation fixing successors and predecessors, pair those before with those arising to those after with those ceasing, each pair a continuation or the same unit, and where the predecessors of the units after stand before and the successors of the units before stand after, arising and ceasing are beginning and ending. Counted, the census needs no decision of identity: under a continuation fixing successors, the units listed once after a step with those a test marks as ceasing are at most the units before with those a test marks as arising, the tests asking only, as far as can be refuted, that a unit marked as ceasing has no successor after and that a unit after not marked as arising has a predecessor before; its mirror holds under a continuation fixing predecessors, and where both are fixed the two meet in the census's count, the tests read off its decision. Each is the corollary of a local form beside it that asks no split (no merge) only among the listed units. The listing and the test are supplied.
laws.zh: 一步之平衡：一关系下两有限列表之完全配对守其数；在「一」之下恰是等长，在空关系下等长不给配对。自所入（先前、所给）至所续（其后、所取）配对之列表有 后 + 取 = 先 + 给，凡合此式之四数皆为「一」下如此配对的单位列表之长。近乎定义。计一域之单位（域读作一判别，此为建模之择），配对守两向皆不出之每一域之数，此域恰是关系所不越者，亦恰是对关系及其逆皆封闭者，单向封闭不足；在由一判别所定之类下，配对恰是每一类中等数，而类有其用（等长者在「一」下配对，在「静」下不配对），故相对于此类之续下之配对守每一类之数。一步之清点：一步前后各列一次之单位，在定后定前之续下，前者并所生者与后者并所亡者一一配对，每对或为续或为同一单位；后列诸单位之前者皆在前列、前列诸单位之后者皆在后列之处，所列之生与亡恰是生与亡。计之，清点不须同一之判定：在定后之续下，一步后各列一次之单位并判别所标为亡者，不过步前之单位并判别所标为生者；判别所问，于可驳之限内，唯标为亡者在后无后者、后列未标为生者在前有前者；定前之续下其镜像亦然；两者皆定之处，二者相会于清点之数，判别读自其判定。每一律为其旁一局部之形之推论，后者只在所列单位之中要求无分裂（无合并）。列表与判别皆为所给。
declarations: Becoming.«对而单闭域不守数之例»
Becoming.«类之对当且仅当类类等数»
Becoming.«定后定前则前并生对后并亡»
Becoming.«前者在前则所列生者生»
Becoming.«后者在后则所列亡者亡»
Becoming.«定后则后并亡不过前并生»
Becoming.«定前则前并生不过后并亡»
Becoming.«定后定前则前并生与后并亡同数»

laws.en: Pairings read backward are pairings under the converse; they compose under the composite (under a transitive relation, under itself), join, and swap under a reflexive one; over a finite family the members' pairings gather; over a stretch, pairings at each step under R give one under R's closure; and the count law over a stretch is exactly a pairing of units over it.
laws.zh: 配对逆读即逆关系下之配对；配对在复合关系下可接（可传递关系下即在其自身之下），可并，在自反关系下可换；有限一族中诸成员之配对可聚；一段中每步于 R 下之配对给出 R 之闭包下的一个配对；一段上之守数律恰是该段上单位之配对。

laws.en: Balance represented in Flow, both ways: a flow balances exactly where, at each step and condition, the units of the level before and what is given pair one to one with those of the level after and what is taken; so at a family's members and over the family, the members' pairings gathered; under any relation a pairing gives balance. Represented, not derived: the consumers stay arithmetic.
laws.zh: Flow 中平衡之表示，两向：一流平衡，恰在每步每条件上先前水平与所给之单位与其后水平与所取之单位一一配对；于一族之诸成员及整族亦然，诸成员之配对相聚；任一关系下之配对给出平衡。表示而不推出：其消费者仍用算术。

laws.en: Steps: the successor fixed, the predecessor fixed (merging nothing, a fixed successor read backward), n steps as the n-fold composite, reaching as some positive number of steps, the closure as some number of steps, steps composing, a loop of p steps a loop of every multiple; where two successors of a place x reaches, each leading on to one of two places, are one, n steps from x lead to one place, the successor fixed at what x reaches being its case, so what ends lies on no longer line from the same place and a line ends at most once; and merging nothing, n steps to one place come from one.
laws.zh: 诸步：定后、定前（不并，即逆读之定后）、n 步即 n 重复合、及即若干正数步、所闭即若干步、步可接、p 步之环即其每一倍数步之环；凡 x 所及之处之二后、各通于二处之一者为一，则自 x 之 n 步至于一处，于 x 所及处定后为其一例，故亡者不在自同处之更长之线上，一线至多一亡；不并时，至一处之 n 步来自一处。

laws.en: Steps counted. n + 1 steps are n steps and then the last. Within m steps and then within n is within m + n, and within n steps is n steps each of which stays or steps. A course of regions each of whose rounds holds exactly what every condition held at the round before holds at round n exactly where everything reaching in n steps held at the start: n rounds of taking on along a relation are one taking on along its n steps. With memory, every round also keeping what it held, it holds exactly where everything reaching within n steps held, the law without memory under staying or a step. Steps split as they compose, and steps read backward are steps of the converse; n steps end where they began or at what the start reaches. Where whatever is reached in fewer than n steps has a successor as far as can be refuted, n steps exist as far as can be refuted, and an unending line has steps of every length.
laws.zh: 计步：n+1 步即 n 步而后一步。m 步以内而后 n 步以内，即 n+m 步以内；n 步以内即「静或缘」之 n 步。区域之程，每轮恰持前一轮诸缘皆持者，则第 n 轮恰持于凡 n 步及之者始皆持之处：沿一关系承 n 轮，即沿其 n 步承一次。有记忆者，每轮兼存其所持，则恰持于凡 n 步以内及之者皆持之处，即「静或缘」下无记忆之律。步可分如其可接，逆读之步即逆缘之步；n 步止于其始，或止于其始之所及。凡少于 n 步所及者或有后，则 n 步或有；不穷之线有任意长之步。

laws.en: «历», passing through a word's relations in turn, with «迭» its case for one relation repeated («迭即历»): it composes along joined words, reads its last letter last and the reversed word by the converse relations backward, merges nothing where no letter merges and keeps alike where each goes alike. The six laws of «迭» are its cases, statements unchanged: «迭之接», «迭之分», «迭之末步», «迭之逆», «迭之定前», «同行之迭».
laws.zh: «历»，依次历一字之诸关系，«迭» 为其一关系重复之例（«迭即历»）：沿相接之字可接，末字母末历，逆字以逆关系倒历，无字母并则不并，各同行则保同行。«迭» 之六律为其例，陈述不改：«迭之接»、«迭之分»、«迭之末步»、«迭之逆»、«迭之定前»、«同行之迭»。

laws.en: Being drawn. For every relation, x is drawn in exactly where it reaches something that does not reach back, and with a successor that does not reach itself it is drawn. With the successor fixed at what x reaches, x reaching itself is not drawn, and with some successor drawn is not reaching itself; the global forms follow. Witnesses: neither hypothesis can be omitted, and the global one is more than the law uses.
laws.zh: 入：对每一关系，x 恰在及于不返者时入；有后而不自返则入。于 x 所及处定后，自返之 x 不入；有后时入即不自返；全局之形为推论。见证：二假设皆不可省，全局之假设多于此律所用。
declarations: Becoming.«定后于有后则入当且仅当不返»
Becoming.«定后有后则入当且仅当不返»

laws.en: Return. Along a line whose places a list holds, merging nothing at its places brings it back to its start within the list's length, by pigeonhole with no decidability, so its start reaches itself; with the successor fixed at what its start reaches, its last place does. On a listed carrier with a successor everywhere, merging nothing makes every place reach itself, and under a fixed successor the two are one.
laws.zh: 返：列表持其诸位之线，若于其诸位不并，则在列表之长内回到其始（无须可判定的鸽笼），故其始自返；于其始所及处定后，其末位自返。于有列表、处处有后之载体上，不并则每处自返，定后之下二者为一。
declarations: Becoming.«有限遍后定后则定前当且仅当皆返»

laws.en: Return and being drawn read on the models, both ways: a process's return is reaching itself under its steps and merging nothing is its predecessor fixed; a law's orbit is its line, reaching is some orbit and return is reaching; absorbing is closed and being drawn is the grammar's. A total lossless process within a list returns everywhere.
laws.zh: 于模型上读返与入，两向：过程之返即在其步下自及，不并即其定前；一律之轨道即其线，及即某一轨道，返即及；吸收即封闭，入即文法之入。在一列表内、全而不并之过程处处返。

laws.en: Rest. Where the steps of a line from T are steps of Q (no rise), and every course of Q steps then an F step (a least fall) ends from its place there, the F steps do not recur, as far as can be refuted and outright, with no decision and no choice. The ending is sufficient, not what rest is. Rest is not being drawn either way: a fixed point at rest and not drawn, a place drawn while its marked steps recur.
laws.zh: 止：一线自 T 起之步皆为 Q 之步（不升），且自其处每一「若干 Q 步继以一 F 步（最小之降）」之程皆尽，则 F 之步不复屡，就可驳而言及径直皆然，无判定无选择。尽为充分，非止本身。止非入，两向：不动点止而不入；一处入而其所标之步屡见。

laws.en: Rest at amounts: within fewer than m least losses, every course of no rise then a least fall ends, so the law of rest over amounts is the grammar's; an amount's strict falls stopping is, by definition, their non-recurrence on the grammar, and falls whose courses end stop. No converse is established.
laws.zh: 量上之止：在少于 m 个最小损失之内，每一「不升继以最小之降」之程皆尽，故量上之止律即文法之止律；一量之严格下降停止，依定义即其在文法上不复屡；诸程皆尽之降停止。未立其逆。

laws.en: Lumping. E goes alike under R (R˘;E;R ⊆ E) where E-alike places go to E-alike ones. With the successor fixed where E leads, constancy is exactly going alike with a successor available there; the global forms are corollaries. With a successor everywhere, a class that goes alike inside a relation lies in the relation's core, and a class going alike in its own; with a fixed successor a class's core goes alike, so with both it is the coarsest class inside the class that does, and off a fixed successor it need not; going alike keeps lines of every length alike, and a map's image has a fixed successor exactly where sameness under the map goes alike. A map preserves a relation exactly where its image lies within the other.
laws.zh: 归并：E 在 R 下同行（R˘;E;R ⊆ E），即 E 下相同者去往 E 下相同者。于 E 所至处定后，有常恰是同行而彼处有后可续；全局之形为推论。遍后，一关系内同行之类含于该关系之核，同行之类含于其己之核；定后，类之核同行，二者兼则为类内最粗之同行之类，后不定则未必；同行使每一长度之线保持相同；映射之像定后，恰在其下之同同行。映射保一关系，恰当该关系沿之之像在另一关系之内。
declarations: Becoming.«局定后则有常当且仅当同行可续»
Becoming.«遍后则其内同行之类含于核»
Becoming.«定后遍后则核为其内最粗同行之类»

laws.en: Lumping read on the models: a determined process has a fixed successor at each move, a description goes alike under a process exactly where it goes alike at each move, and the image of a step along a projection is the grammar's image.
laws.zh: 于模型上读归并：确定之过程在每一移动上定后；一描述在一过程下同行，恰在其于每一移动上同行；一步沿投影之像即文法之像。

laws.en: Widening. Widening of relations (including and exceeding) is irreflexive, one-way and transitive and excludes keeping the same and being mixed; keeping is pointwise equivalence and symmetric, mixed symmetric. Where inclusion or exceeding is decided both ways one of the four cases holds, and deciding it for every pair of relations is exactly excluded middle. For any two relations, a transitive relation joined to the strict part of a transitive relation containing it is transitive, and irreflexive where the first is.
laws.zh: 扩大：关系之扩大（包含且逾越）非自反、单向、可传递，排除保持相同与相杂；保持相同即逐点等价且对称，相杂对称。包含或逾越两向可判定之处，四种情形之一成立；对每一对关系皆可判定，恰是排中律。任两关系：传递关系并入含之之传递关系之严格部分，仍传递；前者非自反处亦非自反。
declarations: Becoming.«则逾之定当且仅当排中»

laws.en: Widening read on the models, both ways: what a level path admits, and what a course admits among listed items, is a coreflexive relation (a partial identity), and the models' inclusion, exceeding, widening, keeping and mixing are the grammar's of these; widening over a listing goes one way and is transitive, from the grammar's laws.
laws.zh: 于模型上读扩大，两向：一水平路径所纳者，及一进程于所列诸项中所纳者，皆为余自反关系（部分同一）；模型之包含、逾越、扩大、保持与相杂即文法对之所言；列表上之扩大单向且可传递，由文法之律而得。

laws.en: Ends on lines. Occurrences listed once, each without a successor and within the closure of a member of a list, number at most the list where two successors of an occurrence a member reaches, each leading to a listed occurrence, are one, with no decision; on the grammar, endings on lines from a list and, at the converse, beginnings on lines to a list number at most the list, the reaching only not refuted where it must be. At stages, each step of the continuation one stage on and the units a region nothing outside continues into: with a list covering the units at one stage (holding every unit of the region there), no unit continuing as two units and nothing beginning over a stretch after the stage, the units ending in the stretch number at most the list, with no decision; mirrored, in a region nothing in it continues out of, with nothing merging and nothing ending in a stretch, the units beginning in it number at most a list covering its end. Through them, with lists covering arbitrarily late stages, endings recurring leave beginnings never stopping, and with each unit after the list's stage decided to begin or to have a predecessor, endings recurring give beginnings recurring; with lists of a bounded length covering every stage from some stage on and nothing merging, beginnings recurring leave endings never stopping, and with each unit decided to end or to have a successor, endings recur. The census of a run is a case: from some step on, nothing splitting and every predecessor of a unit listed after a step listed before it, endings recurring among the listed units need beginnings recurring among the units listed after a step, the beginnings decided by a test; its units read as occurrences at stages, the list at a stage covers it, and the test decides a finite search by the count. Stronger: two hypotheses dropped, the units after each step listed once and a test of endings.
laws.zh: 线上之终。各列一次、各无后且各在一列表某成员之所闭中之处，凡成员所及之处之二后、各通于一所列之处者为一，则其数不过列表，不用判定；在文法上，自一列表之线上之亡，与逆读之，至一列表之线上之生，其数皆不过列表，所及须时只须不可驳。于诸阶上，续之每步进一阶，单位为外无续入之域：一列表覆一阶之单位（含此阶上域之每一单位），无单位续为二，此阶后一段内无生，则此段内亡之单位不过列表，不用判定；其镜像，于内无续出之域，无并，一段内无亡，则此段内生之单位不过覆其末之列表。由之，列表覆任意晚之阶，则亡屡而生不止；列表之阶后每单位之生或有前已判定，则亡屡则生屡；有界长之列表覆自某阶起之每阶而无并，则生屡而亡不止；每单位之亡或有后已判定，则亡屡。一程之清点为其一例：自某步起，无分裂、步后所列单位之前者皆列于其前，所列单位中亡屡则步后所列单位中生屡，生由一判别所定；其单位读作各阶之处，一阶之列表覆之，判别以计数决一有限之搜。更强：去二前提，即步后之单位各列一次与亡之判别。
declarations: Becoming.«间无生则间亡不过所覆»
Becoming.«间无亡则间生不过所覆»
Becoming.«有界覆而生屡则亡不止»
Becoming.«定后前者在前则亡屡者生屡»

laws.en: The models' laws of closure, return, being drawn, rest at amounts, lumping and widening are proved from these in their own modules, each keeping its name and statement: board rule 9, the general law below proving the special one, with no second proof left beside it. The list lemmas the models held, pigeonhole among them, are now names of the grammar's one proof. Among them: structure and change are one lumping, the image law on a determined law's one move; the case split of the step back of a returning configuration, the grammar's decomposition of reach, by which every loss passes a juncture; the repetition of the lasso of a world a list holds, a loop then d steps leading where d steps lead under a fixed successor, its bound pigeonhole; and the lagged orders of courses and of what can be reached, from the relation laws. And the models' step-indexed laws: giving that waits on giving, with memory and without, from the laws of taking on, a chain of waits read as the grammar's steps; and a course carrying every bound on realizing a bundle together, from the composition of within, a trace read as the grammar's steps; and an unending line reaching an occurrence at every later step, from its steps of every length, k steps advancing the index by k; and the inductions over steps that keep a region, from a region every step keeps holding from where it holds on: never arising from an inactive start being never active, activity and presence kept back, an ending kept, a name kept over a held stretch, and a carrier and the pattern's line traced back; and the lineage laws under a continuation, a lineage read as the grammar's steps of the continuation within activity: reaching at most one formation at each step without splits and starting from one without merges, splitting as its steps split, going on where nothing ceases and back where nothing arises, as far as can be refuted, and a lineage being a line under activity and a line from an active occurrence a lineage; and the image of a step along a projection the least process the step factors through, from preserving read through the image.
laws.zh: 模型上闭包、返、入、量上之止、归并与扩大之律，皆在其本模块中由此诸律证出，各保其名与陈述：即板规九，下层之通律证其特例，旁无第二证明。模型原有之列表引理（鸽笼在内）今为文法唯一证明之别名。其中：结构与变化同为一种归并，即像之律施于定律之一步；返者之退一步之分情，即文法对所及之分解，由之每一失皆经一岔口；列表所持之世之套索之重复：定后之下，一环之后 d 步至于 d 步所至，其界则为鸽笼；进程与所可及者之滞后之序，出自关系之律。又诸模型计步之律：待施之施，有记忆与无记忆，出自承之律，待之链读为文法之步；进程携同时实现一束之每一界，出自以内之接，迹读为文法之步；不穷之线于其后每一步皆有所及，出自其任意长之步，k 步则指标增 k；又守一域之逐步归纳，出自每步皆守之域自其所守处以后皆守：自不活跃之始而永不生则永不活跃、活跃与在场之回溯、终之所守、持守之段上之一名，以及载者与样式之线之回溯；又续之下之谱系诸律，谱系读为活跃之内续之文法之步：无分则每步所及至多一者，无合则所出唯一，随其步之分而分，无止则或续往，无生则或回溯；谱系即活跃之下之线，自活跃者出之线即谱系；又步沿投影之像为步所经之最小进程，出自沿像读之保。

hypotheses.en: None beyond the grammar and the models' representation: every carrier and relation, counting entering only through finite lists as in the models. Each global form takes a fixed successor, merging nothing, a successor everywhere or a list of the carrier, as a corollary of a local form that asks it only where the proof uses it.
hypotheses.zh: 除文法与诸模型之表示外不加前提：对每一载体与关系，计数只经有限列表而入，如诸模型。每一全局之形取定后、不并、处处有后或载体之列表，为一局部之形之推论，后者只在证明所用之处要求之。

hypotheses.en: The bridges read each anchor at its model's relation: a process's steps, a law's map, what a level path or a listed course admits as a coreflexive relation, a flow's levels, takes and gives as lists of units, and an amount's no rise and least fall as steps.
hypotheses.zh: 诸桥于其模型之关系上读每一锚：过程之步、律之映射、水平路径或所列进程之所纳（作为余自反关系）、流之水平与取给（作为单位列表）、量之不升与最小之降（作为步）。

hypotheses.en: Counting reads a region, the class counted in and a continuation each as a test to Bool (a modelling choice; a proposition enters by decide), and the census of a step lists the units before and after once each; counted, the census reads arising and ceasing (along a run, beginnings) by tests on the listed units in place of a test of the continuation.
hypotheses.zh: 计数读所计之域、所计之类与续各为取真假值之测（建模之择；命题经判定而入），一步之清点所列前后之单位各只一次；计之，清点以所列单位上生起与止息（沿一程则生）之测代续之测。

hypotheses.en: The forms at stages read the units at stages, each step of the continuation one stage on (discrete steps, a modelling choice), and the units a region whose conditions are closed regions: nothing outside it continuing into it, and for the mirror nothing in it continuing out of it; a list covers a stage where it holds every unit of the region there.
hypotheses.zh: 诸阶之形读单位于各阶，续之每步进一阶（离散之步，建模之择），单位为一域，其条件为闭域：外无续入，镜像则内无续出；一列表覆一阶，谓其含此阶上域之每一单位。

does_not_show.en: That any model's relation is functional, total or listed: the models supply these, and the global forms take them as hypotheses.
does_not_show.zh: 任一模型之关系为函数、为全或有列表：此由模型提供，全局之形以之为假设。

does_not_show.en: A derivation of balance: the pairing is supplied by the representation rather than drawn from the unfolding, and gives no trajectory of units; balance's consumers keep their arithmetic.
does_not_show.zh: 平衡之推出：配对由表示给定，而非得自展开，不给出单位之轨迹；平衡之消费者仍用算术。

does_not_show.en: A converse of the law of rest, from rest along a line to the ending of the courses: none is established, and one would have to say which step relations it compares and on what logic.
does_not_show.zh: 止律之逆，即由沿线之止至诸程之尽：未立；若立之，须说明所比之步关系及所用之逻辑。

does_not_show.en: That rest is a case of being drawn, or being drawn a case of rest.
does_not_show.zh: 止为入之一例，或入为止之一例。

does_not_show.en: That a pairing under continuation adds anything to equal count beyond what is now stated, the count on every region it does not cross and, under a class decided by a test, in every class; or the n-step law for lines of different lengths.
does_not_show.zh: 续之下之配对于等长之外、于今所述（其所不越之每一域守数，及一测所定之类下每一类守数）之外有所增益，或不同长度之线的 n 步之律。

does_not_show.en: The models' other laws on the grammar: they are proved on their models and not yet restated on it.
does_not_show.zh: 诸模型之其他律在文法上：它们在其模型上证明，尚未在文法上重述。

does_not_show.en: That the anchors Branching.Returns, Branching.Lossless, GoAlikeUnder, Web.Widens and Weighting.WidensOn are their grammar terms by definition: each is equivalent to its grammar term by a representation theorem, not equal to it by rfl, and none is redefined (OU3c's audit).
does_not_show.zh: 锚 Branching.Returns、Branching.Lossless、GoAlikeUnder、Web.Widens 与 Weighting.WidensOn 以定义即其文法之项：各以表示定理与其文法之项等价，而非依 rfl 相等，亦无一被重定义（OU3c 之审查）。

does_not_show.en: That C's extension on the paths of a web is a case of the grammar's widening (Web.paths_extension_iff_widens, Direction.extension_iff_widens, Web.paths_comparison_widens, and Web.paths_one_object, which also takes the next item): its content is a reindexing of claims, (formation, step), to admissions, (step, formation), with every claim counted; widening enters by its definition, and reaching the grammar would need a transport of «广» along the swap of a pair, adding machinery and no content.
does_not_show.zh: 网之诸路上 C 之扩展为文法之扩大之例（Web.paths_extension_iff_widens、Direction.extension_iff_widens、Web.paths_comparison_widens，及兼取下一条之 Web.paths_one_object）：其内容为把主张（构成、步）重排为所纳（步、构成），每一主张皆计；扩大只以其定义入，及于文法须沿对之交换移运 «广»，徒增工具而无内容。

does_not_show.en: That the reduction of what has significance to what can form under the continuation condition is a law of the grammar (Web.widens_iff_retains_adds): the free significance is not lifted to the root.
does_not_show.zh: 在延续条件下，把有意义者归约为可成形者，为文法之律（Web.widens_iff_retains_adds）：自由之意义未升至根。

does_not_show.en: That widening being, on a finite listing, what every additive weighting positive on each listed item ranks higher is a law of the grammar (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive): the grammar has no weights.
does_not_show.zh: 扩大在有限列举上即每一在每个所列项上为正之可加权重皆排之更高者，为文法之律（Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive）：文法无权重。

does_not_show.en: That a part whose law is determined, forming its own move, carries a law of its own by a law of the grammar (PartForms.goAlike): its content is the model's premise, the part's law determined at a move the part alone forms. The image law only reads the conclusion as carrying a law of its own (carries_law_iff); a proof through it applies the law and undoes it, and constancy with a fixed successor would need the rest to step and be determined (OU3d's review).
does_not_show.zh: 定律之部分，自成其动者，依文法之律自有其律（PartForms.goAlike）：其内容为模型之前提，即此部分之律于唯此部分所成之动定后。像之律只将结论读为自有其律（carries_law_iff）；经之之证，施此律而复撤之；有常与定后则须他部亦动且定（OU3d 之审查）。

detail.en: Equal count without a pairing: under the empty relation two one-place lists have one length and no pairing («等长而不对之例»).
detail.zh: 等长而无配对：空关系下两个单位列表等长而无配对（«等长而不对之例»）。

detail.en: Drawn and returning where the successor is not fixed («入而返之例»); returning and not drawn with no fixed successor anywhere («非定后返而不入之例»).
detail.zh: 后不定处既入且返（«入而返之例»）；处处不定后而返且不入（«非定后返而不入之例»）。

detail.en: Rest is not being drawn: a line that falls once and then stays at a fixed point is at rest, and that place is not drawn («止而不入之例»), and along the successor on the whole numbers 0 is drawn while its marked steps recur («入而屡之例»).
detail.zh: 止非入：一落之后住于不动点者止，其处不入（«止而不入之例»）；沿自然数之后继，0 入而其所标之步屡见（«入而屡之例»）。

validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 core receipt 20261101T161537.177111Z: GrammarLaws, 223 theorems in 252 declarations; 40 representation and bridge declarations in 14 models; derivations in 14 more (OU3c, OU3e, OU3f) and in Mechanism, Response, SelectionPool, Locality, Decidedness and Identity (HE, HE2, U4d); axiom reports empty, all cited. Statements unchanged but, per the history, laws taken to any universe, renames, one law widened, an instance dropped from eight laws, two hypotheses dropped from the census of a run. Read-only AI reviews of each item, all findings taken, five twice; no person's review recorded.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 核心回执 20261101T161537.177111Z：GrammarLaws 252 声明中定理 223；十四模型 40 表示桥接声明；另十四模块（OU3c、OU3e、OU3f）与 Mechanism、Response、SelectionPool、Locality、Decidedness、Identity（HE、HE2、U4d）之推导；公理报告皆空，皆引。陈述不变，唯据历史：推至任一宇宙、改名、放宽一律、八律去一实例、一程清点去二前提。只读 AI 审各项，皆采，五项复审；尚无人审之记录。

next_delta.en: A derivation of balance where a model's balance is read under a relation other than the one, pairings composing along a supplied conditioning; the models' other central laws restated on the grammar; a converse of the law of rest with the step relations it compares and its logic stated; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 平衡之推出：在模型之平衡于「一」以外之关系下读出之处，配对沿给定之缘而接；诸模型其他核心律在文法上重述；止律之逆，须说明所比之步关系及其逻辑；人之审查。

correspondence.en: Closure is the reflexive-transitive closure of a relation read as the least closed region; balance on the grammar is the cardinality reading of a natural-number equation by a bijection of finite lists; return and being drawn are the finite-state facts of a relation's paths, by pigeonhole; going alike (R˘;E;R ⊆ E) is the relational condition under which a quotient of a deterministic system is again one, as in lumpability; widening is strict inclusion with a witness. The readings are the AI's, in development/ou3b-master-laws-on-the-grammar (DESIGN, OU3b2-NOTES, AUDIT), with its three reviews.
correspondence.zh: 闭包即关系之自反传递闭包，读作最小封闭域；文法上之平衡，以有限列表之双射读自然数等式之基数；返与入即关系路径之有限状态事实（鸽笼）；同行（R˘;E;R ⊆ E）即确定系统之商仍为确定系统之关系条件，如可归并性；扩大即带见证之严格包含。读法皆 AI 之读，载于 development/ou3b-master-laws-on-the-grammar（DESIGN、OU3b2-NOTES、AUDIT），附其三次审查。

detail.zh: 诸支皆尽（«尽»），止律之前提。

detail.zh: 框架之 ClosedUnder 与 WithinClosure，今依定义即文法之 «闭» 与 «所闭»；其律由文法之律证出。

detail.en: Flow.Balances, Flow.BalancesOn and Flow.Balances.over, represented as pairings of units.
detail.zh: Flow.Balances、Flow.BalancesOn 与 Flow.Balances.over，以单位之配对表示。

detail.en: Law.lossless_iff_returns, revisits_within and the orbit laws, now proved from the line laws.
detail.zh: Law.lossless_iff_returns、revisits_within 与诸轨道之律，今由诸线律证出。

detail.en: Branching.Returns and Branching.Lossless, read as reaching itself and the predecessor fixed.
detail.zh: Branching.Returns 与 Branching.Lossless，读作自及与定前。

detail.en: Law.Drawn and Law.drawn_iff_not_returns, now the grammar's «入» and its law.
detail.zh: Law.Drawn 与 Law.drawn_iff_not_returns，今即文法之 «入» 及其律。

detail.en: Amounts.rests_unrefuted and Amounts.rests, now proved from «尽则不或屡» with Amounts.falls_end.
detail.zh: Amounts.rests_unrefuted 与 Amounts.rests，今由 «尽则不或屡» 与 Amounts.falls_end 证出。

detail.en: Amounts.FallsStop, by definition the grammar's non-recurrence of strict falls.
detail.zh: Amounts.FallsStop，依定义即文法上严格下降之不复屡。

detail.en: GoAlikeUnder, image_determined_iff and carries_law_iff, now from «像定后当且仅当同行».
detail.zh: GoAlikeUnder、image_determined_iff 与 carries_law_iff，今由 «像定后当且仅当同行» 而得。

detail.en: constant_of_goAlike and goAlike_of_constant, now from the lumping laws.

detail.zh: Weighting.IncludesOn、ExceedsOn、WidensOn 与 MixedOn，读作文法于所列诸项上之比较。

detail.en: Transfers along a relation balance a step exactly where the total is conserved on every family it closes: where a derivation of balance under a relation other than the one would begin.

history.en: 26 October 2026: added (OU3b, with OU3b-2 and OU3b-3), the five master laws on the grammar and the models' laws proved from them, balance represented and not derived; three independent reviews taken; study section 417.
history.zh: 2026年10月26日：新增（OU3b，含 OU3b-2 与 OU3b-3），文法上之五条主律，模型之律由之证出，平衡表示而不推出；三次独立审查皆采；研究第 417 节。

history.en: 28 October 2026 (OU3c, study section 433): the two relation laws moved into the grammar and the lagged orders proved from them; structure and change as one lumping proved from the image law, the case split of the step back of a returning configuration from the decomposition of reach, and the repetition of a lasso from the laws of steps. No anchor is its grammar term by rfl, so each keeps its definition; the reasons for the other consumers are in OU3c's audit.
history.zh: 2026年10月28日（OU3c，研究第 433 节）：二关系律移入文法，滞后之序由之证出；结构与变化同为一种归并由像之律证出，返者之退一步之分情由所及之分解证出，套索之重复由步之律证出。无一锚依 rfl 即其文法之项，故各保其定义；其余依之者之理由见 OU3c 之审查。

history.en: 28 October 2026 (OU3d, study section 437): steps counted on the grammar, beside n steps: the last step, within n steps and its composition, and the laws of taking on without memory and with, the closed forms of the models' step-indexed laws, stated before any of them bridges to them; and the part's own law (PartForms.goAlike) given its reason: a law of its model, not a case of a grammar law.
history.zh: 2026年10月28日（OU3d，研究第 437 节）：于文法上计步，置于 n 步之旁：末一步、n 步以内及其接、无记忆与有记忆之承之律，即诸模型计步之律之闭式，先于其桥接而立；又部分自有其律（PartForms.goAlike）得其理由：为其模型之律，非文法之律之例。

history.en: 28 October 2026 (OU3e, study section 439): the models' step-indexed laws proved from the laws of steps counted: Withholding's two closed forms from the laws of taking on, a chain of waits read as the grammar's steps, and WithinMoves.after_course from the composition of within, a trace read as them; the does-not-show item on their bridges removed.
history.zh: 2026年10月28日（OU3e，研究第 439 节）：诸模型计步之律由计步之律证出：Withholding 之二闭式出自承之律，待之链读为文法之步；WithinMoves.after_course 出自以内之接，迹读为文法之步；其桥接之「未示」一条删去。

history.en: 29 October 2026 (OU3f, study section 442): laws of steps the grammar lacked, which the audit of the theorems reading only activity found the lineage laws need, stated beside n steps before any of them bridges: steps split as they compose and steps read backward, steps where successors are given as far as can be refuted, and an unending line's steps of every length; the web lemma that an unending line reaches every later step proved from the last (board rule 9), so the five activity laws resting on it reach the grammar.
history.zh: 2026年10月29日（OU3f，研究第 442 节）：文法所缺之步之律，即只读活跃之定理之审计所见 Lineage 诸律之所需，先于其桥接而置于 n 步之旁：步可分如其可接与逆读之步、后或有则步或有、不穷之线有任意长之步；不穷之线于其后每一步皆有所及之网之引理由末者证出（板规九），故依之之五条活跃之律达于文法。

history.en: 29 October 2026 (OU3f, study section 445): the closure at the successor along a line, that a region every step keeps holds from where it holds on (kept_onward, in Becoming.KeptOnward, its home beside «线则所闭» in GrammarLaws), and the eight inductions over steps in six model modules proved by it in place of their own (board rule 9), statements unchanged.

history.en: 31 October 2026, board item HE2 (study section 474). Items 2 to 4: the closure law gains «所闭之逆» and the two laws of a closure through borrowed steps («借步之所闭在二所闭», «二所闭在借步之所闭»), which Response's WithinClosure.converse and SelectionPool's WithinClosure.of_reads and WithinClosureOf.to_reads are now proved as; balance at one step gains counting on a region («计»), the count kept where the relation does not cross, the count law of a class, what a pairing under continuation adds to equal count and the census of a step, with two witnesses (U4's lever 1, checked outside the package before); the list lemmas gain the helpers these use; the models' laws proved from these gain the three model lemmas, with Response.lean and SelectionPool.lean as proof sources. Item 6: the lumping law gains four laws on a class's core and going alike in GrammarLaws («定后则类之核同行», «遍后则其内同行之类含于核», «定后遍后则核为其内最粗同行之类», and the witness «后不定则核可不同行»), the composition 01 §4 states under "The core and 理", checked outside the package before; and a correction: the clause "a class going alike lies in its core" was false without the successor everywhere that «类同行遍后则含于核» takes, and now carries it. The landing: the validation scope gives HE2's receipt and GrammarLaws' counts, every declaration cited; the does-not-show item on a pairing under continuation is narrowed to what is not stated, as GrammarLaws' module doc is; a hypothesis names what counting reads as a test to Bool and the census's lists without repeats; the balance law's last sentence no longer says the pairing is supplied, since the census constructs its own; the home section, 01 §7, now states the closure and balance laws items 2 to 4 add; HE2's design, review and receipt are referenced. No other law changes.
history.zh: 2026年10月31日，工作板条目 HE2（研究第 474 节）。第 2 至 4 项：闭包之律增入 «所闭之逆» 及借步之闭包二律（«借步之所闭在二所闭»、«二所闭在借步之所闭»），Response 之 WithinClosure.converse 与 SelectionPool 之 WithinClosure.of_reads、WithinClosureOf.to_reads 今即由之证出；一步之平衡增入计一域之数（«计»）、关系所不越之域守数、类之数律、续下配对于等数之所增与一步之清点，并二见证（U4 之第一杠杆，此前在包外核验）；列表引理增入其所用之辅助；由此证出之诸模型之律增入此三模型引理，以 Response.lean 与 SelectionPool.lean 为证明来源。第 6 项：归并之律增入 GrammarLaws 中言类之核与同行之四律（«定后则类之核同行»、«遍后则其内同行之类含于核»、«定后遍后则核为其内最粗同行之类»，及见证 «后不定则核可不同行»），即第一章 §4「核与理」所述之组合，此前在包外核验；并更正：「同行之类含于其核」一句无「类同行遍后则含于核」所设之遍后则不真，今带之。落地：验证范围言 HE2 之回执与 GrammarLaws 之数，声明皆引；续下配对之「未示」一项收窄至未述者，如 GrammarLaws 之模块说明；增一前提，言计数所读之取真假值之测与一步之清点所列无重；平衡之律末句不再言配对为所给，因清点自造其配对；其所在之节第一章 §7 今述第 2 至 4 项所增之闭包与平衡之律；HE2 之设计、审查与回执已引。其余之律不变。

history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 ND：由“文法上的主律”更名为“文法上的共律”；旧名言等级，而 08 §7 所量唯证明之依赖。旧名留为别名，编号留为键；律、假设与绑定皆未改。

history.en: 1 November 2026, U4c (study section 492): law 4, balance at one step, gains the census counted: the root's census of a step, one side («定后则后并亡不过前并生»), its mirror («定前则前并生不过后并亡»), the two meeting in the count of the paired census («定后定前则前并生与后并亡同数»), and the census of a run («定后前者在前则亡屡者生屡»), each the corollary of a local form asking no split (no merge) only among the listed units (GrammarLaws.census_le, census_le_converse, census_count, census_run), as the first hypothesis says of every global form; law 3 and the GrammarLaws reference gain the five list lemmas they use, in GrammarLaws' namespace, law 3 naming the census of a run, and the third hypothesis says what the counted census tests. U4c's derivations: Listed.coming_of_ceasing, Listed.across_at and Web.Census.balanceFrom_at, re-proved as cases in Population and Identity; its changed statements: three list lemmas moved to the prelude at any universe, and eight census laws of Identity without the instance deciding the continuation; its design and reviews join the references (CENSUS-ON-THE-ROOT.md; REVIEW-U4C.md and REVIEW-U4C-RECORD.md, each with a second pass). The validation scope, at its length, now leaves the list of changed statements to these notes and counts the reviews without listing them by item, each referenced from its item's records. Nothing else the record states changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，U4c（研究第 492 节）：律 4（一步之平衡）增计之清点：根上一步之清点之一边（«定后则后并亡不过前并生»）、其镜像（«定前则前并生不过后并亡»）、二者相会于成对清点之数（«定后定前则前并生与后并亡同数»）、一程之清点（«定后前者在前则亡屡者生屡»），各为一局部之形之推论，后者只在所列单位之中要求无分裂（无合并）（GrammarLaws.census_le、census_le_converse、census_count、census_run），如第一假设之言每一全局之形；律 3 与 GrammarLaws 之引用增其所用之五列表引理，在 GrammarLaws 之名下，律 3 名一程之清点，第三假设言计之清点所测。U4c 之推导：Listed.coming_of_ceasing、Listed.across_at 与 Web.Census.balanceFrom_at 改证为其例，在 Population 与 Identity；其所改之陈述：三列表引理移入序章、推至任一宇宙，Identity 八条清点之律去判定延续之实例；其设计与审查入引用（CENSUS-ON-THE-ROOT.md；REVIEW-U4C.md 与 REVIEW-U4C-RECORD.md，皆经复审）。验证范围限于其长，今以改动陈述之列交此诸说明，审查只计其数而不逐项列之，各见引于其项之记录。记录所述余无改变。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item OU7 (study section 492): the grammar's owner's items held from BD2 (patches/owner/02-04). «不出», «闭则不出» and «所闭不出» move from GrammarCrossing into GrammarLaws, after «所闭之界», unchanged; not-going-out-of-a-region states them, and here only the validation scope's counts hold them. A region not crossed is exactly one not gone out of either way and one closed both ways (GrammarLaws.uncrossed_iff_notGoingOut, GrammarLaws.uncrossed_iff_closed, BD2's text), so law 4 reads its two count laws as one law on regions not gone out of either way, and its home in 01 §7 says the same: law 4 and the GrammarLaws reference gain the two. The validation scope's receipt and counts are receipt 20261101T094230.205342Z's. Nothing else the record states changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 OU7（研究第 492 节）：文法之主人于 BD2 所留之项（patches/owner/02-04）。«不出»、«闭则不出» 与 «所闭不出» 自 GrammarCrossing 移入 GrammarLaws，在 «所闭之界» 之后，原样不变；陈之者为 not-going-out-of-a-region，于此唯验证范围之数目含之。关系所不越之域恰是两向皆不出者，亦恰是两向皆闭者（GrammarLaws.uncrossed_iff_notGoingOut、GrammarLaws.uncrossed_iff_closed，BD2 之文），故律 4 读其二守数之律为两向皆不出之域上之一律，其归处 01 §7 亦如是言：律 4 与 GrammarLaws 之引用增此二者。验证范围之回执与数目为收据 20261101T094230.205342Z 者。记录所述余无改变。

history.en: 1 November 2026, U4d (study section 498): a new law 19, ends on lines, before the models' law, now law 20. It holds the count of ends on lines from a list («线终不过所列»), endings and, at the converse, beginnings on lines («线亡不过所列», «线生不过所列», each with its not-refuted form), the stretch form at stages and its mirror («间无生则间亡不过所覆», «间无亡则间生不过所覆»), and the run forms («所覆后亡屡则有生», «有覆而亡屡则生屡», «所覆后亡屡则生未否», «有覆而亡屡则生不止», «有界覆而生屡则亡不止», «有界覆而生屡则亡屡»). The census of a run (GrammarLaws.census_run, «定后前者在前则亡屡者生屡») moves into it from law 4 and is proved through the stretch form, stronger: two hypotheses dropped, the units after each step listed once and the test of endings; its finite search is by the count (GrammarLaws.stage_search). Law 7 gains the line lemmas («所闭当且仅当有迭», «分处定后则迭之定于», of which «迭之定于» is now the case, «亡者不在长迭», «定后则线至多一亡»). The statement names ends on lines among the finite runs; the third hypothesis drops the test of endings along a run, and a fourth states the forms at stages. U4d's derivations, re-proved as cases with statements unchanged: Locality's Covers.coming_from_of_ceasing, Covers.ceasing_steps_within, Covers.not_not_coming_from and Covers.ceasing_stops_unrefuted, Decidedness' ceasing_steps_within and coming_steps_within, and Identity's Web.not_not_arisingFrom_covered and Web.ceasingFrom_not_stopping_covered, with Identity's census recurrence laws through its new exact forms. Its design and review join the references (COVERING-ON-THE-ROOT.md, REVIEW-U4D.md). The GrammarLaws reference and the validation scope's receipt and counts are receipt 20261101T161537.177111Z's. Nothing else the record states changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，U4d（研究第 498 节）：新律 19，线上之终，在诸模型之律之前，后者今为律 20。其含自一列表之线上之终之计（«线终不过所列»）、线上之亡与逆读之线上之生（«线亡不过所列»、«线生不过所列»，各有其不可驳之形）、诸阶上之段之形及其镜像（«间无生则间亡不过所覆»、«间无亡则间生不过所覆»），与程之诸形（«所覆后亡屡则有生»、«有覆而亡屡则生屡»、«所覆后亡屡则生未否»、«有覆而亡屡则生不止»、«有界覆而生屡则亡不止»、«有界覆而生屡则亡屡»）。一程之清点（GrammarLaws.census_run、«定后前者在前则亡屡者生屡»）自律 4 移入，经段之形而证，更强：去二前提，即步后之单位各列一次与亡之判别；其有限之搜以计数行之（GrammarLaws.stage_search）。律 7 增线之引理（«所闭当且仅当有迭»、«分处定后则迭之定于»，«迭之定于» 今为其一例，«亡者不在长迭»、«定后则线至多一亡»）。陈述于有限运行中增线上之终；第三前提去沿一程之亡之判别，第四前提陈诸阶之形。U4d 之推导，皆作为例重证，陈述不变：Locality 之 Covers.coming_from_of_ceasing、Covers.ceasing_steps_within、Covers.not_not_coming_from 与 Covers.ceasing_stops_unrefuted，Decidedness 之 ceasing_steps_within 与 coming_steps_within，Identity 之 Web.not_not_arisingFrom_covered 与 Web.ceasingFrom_not_stopping_covered，Identity 之清点递现之律经其新确切之形。其设计与审查入引用（COVERING-ON-THE-ROOT.md、REVIEW-U4D.md）。GrammarLaws 之引用与验证范围之回执与数目为收据 20261101T161537.177111Z 者。记录所述余无改变。

history.en: 3 November 2026, CD (board item CD): the shared law labelled "order" is labelled "widening" in the statement and in laws 17, 18 and 20, with 01 §7, 08 §7 and the view's display name. Under the glossary's one sense, ranking and order (the ethics' role word) say which course is better, and widening says which admits more, with no premise; this law is widening and its laws as a strict partial order. Its content, laws, anchors and key are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年11月3日，工作板条目 CD：标为“序”的共律，于陈述及律 17、18、20 中改标为“扩大”，与 01 §7、08 §7 及视图的显示名一致。按词汇表的单一词义，排序与次序（伦理的角色词）说哪个进程更好，扩大说哪个所纳更多，不需前提；此律即扩大及其作为严格偏序之律。内容、诸律、锚点与键不变。
